title: Trump touts renovation projects instead of addressing cost of living in final midterm push
summary: President Trump made his final pitch to voters from the Reflecting Pool in Washington, D.C., on Monday. He held up photos of his various renovation projects, rather than take on cost-of-living issues, which voters say matter to them most. Weijia Jiang has more details on his closing pitch and Ed O'Keefe has the races to watch on Election Day.
